max_streams.description: Maximum number of audio streams allowed per client

mem_lock.description: Whether to lock memory pages (prevents swapping, improves latency)

sample_rate.description: Default sample rate in Hz (44100 or 48000 common)

default_sink.description: Default audio output sink ID (e.g., '0' for first device)

enable_spare_nodes.description: Whether to pre-allocate spare sink/source nodes for hot-plug resilience

spare_sinks.description: Number of spare audio sinks to keep ready (only if spare nodes enabled)

spare_sources.description: Number of spare audio sources (e.g., for mic hot-plug)

volume_boost_db.description: Maximum allowed volume boost in decibels (e.g., 15.0 = +15 dB)

modules.description: List of PulseAudio modules to load with custom arguments

optional_plugins.description: Optional SPA plugins to enable or disable

description.description: Brief description of the plugin's purpose

enable_system_mode.description: Enable system-wide PipeWire PulseAudio daemon (typically disabled for desktop; used for servers)
